description:
A customer brings in a defective computer and the CRS checks the defect and hands out a repair cost calculation back.
If the customer decides that the costs are acceptable, the process continues, otherwise she takes her computer home unrepaired.
The ongoing repair consists of two activities, which are executed, in an arbitrary order.
The first activity is to check and repair the hardware, whereas the second activity checks and configures the software.
After each of these activities, the proper system functionality is tested.
If an error is detected another arbitrary repair activity is executed, otherwise the repair is finished.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_RepairService" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Repair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DefectiveComputer" name="Bring in defective computer" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_DefectiveComputer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairCost" name="Repair cost calculation" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCost" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostAcceptance" name="Cost acceptance" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Catch_CostAcceptance"/>

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RepairCost" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CostAcceptance" name="Cost acceptance"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_DefectiveComputer" name="Defective computer received">

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CostAcceptance" messageRef="Msg_CostAcceptance"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CostOK" name="Costs acceptable?" default="Flow_CostRejected"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderSplit" name="Choose repair order"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHW1" name="Test hardware functionality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SWConfig1" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSW1" name="Test software functionality"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SWConfig2" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSW2" name="Test software functionality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HWRepair2" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHW2" name="Test hardware functionality"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorMerge" name="Repair order completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorCheck" name="Error detected?" default="Flow_NoError"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Repaired" name="Repair finished"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ArbSplit" name="Choose repair activity"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HWRepair3" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SWConfig3" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ArbJoin" name="Repair activity completed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestRepair" name="Test system functionality"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_DefectiveComputer" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_CalculateCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CalculateCost" targetRef="SendTask_SendCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCost" targetRef="Catch_CostAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Catch_CostAcceptance" targetRef="Gateway_CostOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CostAccepted" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CostOK" targetRef="Gateway_OrderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CostRejected" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CostOK" targetRef="End_Unrepaired"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderA_Start" name="Hardware first" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderSplit" targetRef="Task_HWRepair1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderB_Start" name="Software first" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderSplit" targetRef="Task_SWConfig2"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Task_HWRepair1" targetRef="Task_TestHW1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_TestHW1" targetRef="Task_SWConfig1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Task_SWConfig1" targetRef="Task_TestSW1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Task_TestSW1" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B1" sourceRef="Task_SWConfig2" targetRef="Task_TestSW2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B2" sourceRef="Task_TestSW2" targetRef="Task_HWRepair2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B3" sourceRef="Task_HWRepair2" targetRef="Task_TestHW2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B4" sourceRef="Task_TestHW2" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Error" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ArbSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoError" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck" targetRef="End_Repaired"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Arb_HW" name="Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_ArbSplit" targetRef="Task_HWRepair3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Arb_SW" name="Software" sourceRef="Gateway_ArbSplit" targetRef="Task_SWConfig3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_HWRepair3" targetRef="Gateway_ArbJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_SWConfig3" targetRef="Gateway_ArbJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_ArbJoin" targetRef="Task_TestRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_TestRepair" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
